annotations.title: My Video Channel — Share Videos with a Link

description: Upload your videos once, then share your whole channel or just one video with a link. No ads, no algorithm. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

about.description: createChannel and renameChannel: a line shown under the channel's name, up to 500 characters.

action.description: add (default) puts an uploaded video on one of the caller's channels and returns its link and the channel's link. list returns every channel with its videos and tokens. edit changes one video by token (title, description, listed, or channelToken to move it). remove deletes one video and its file. createChannel makes a new channel (name, about). renameChannel changes a channel's name or about text. deleteChannel deletes a channel with every video on it.

channelToken.description: Which channel, from list or createChannel. add: the channel to put the video on (omit to use the newest channel, or make a first one if there is none). edit: the channel to move the video to. renameChannel and deleteChannel: required.

description.description: Text shown under the video, up to 2000 characters. Plain text.

durationMs.description: add only: the length in milliseconds, if known.

fileId.description: add only: the id of a video file the caller already owns. Upload it first with POST /v1/files/upload-url, a PUT of the bytes, then POST /v1/files/confirm. An H.264 MP4 plays in every browser; other formats may not play on every device.

height.description: add only: the height in pixels, if known.

listed.description: true (default) shows the video on its channel page. false makes it link only (unlisted): reachable by its own link and not shown on the channel.

locale.description: add and createChannel: the language a new channel's pages are written in (en, de, es, fr, it, nl, pl, pt, fi). Default en.

name.description: createChannel and renameChannel: the channel's name, up to 60 characters. add: used only if the caller has no channel yet and one is made.

posterFileId.description: add only: optional id of an uploaded image (JPEG or PNG) shown before the video plays.

title.description: The video's title, up to 100 characters. Required for add.

token.description: edit and remove: the video's token, from list or from add's answer.

width.description: add only: the width in pixels, if known.
